name: Linda Sánchez

items.text: In June 2010 Sánchez criticized Arizona's SB 1070. In a statement on June 4, 2010, she said she had never said everyone who supports the law is a racist or white supremacist. She said she stood behind her statements about the law's authors.
items.why: This is a 2010 political remark about the people behind a law, with no finding and no bearing on foreign ties, big money, real work, doing the job, or abuse of office (criteria 1–6).

for_review: The owner-sites search (alexjoneslive.com, stewpeters.com, ryandawson.org, infowars.com) returned nothing about Sánchez. I couldn't open the original Whittier Daily News story, because the Daily Titan reprint failed to load. I only saw the Fox News and Daily Titan snippets in search results, and they match the quotes in the item. Sánchez said she based the remark on online stories, and I have not checked whether her claim about the law's drafters holds up. I did not weigh attendance.
